cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)

# CMake requires a literal project() call in the top-level CMakeLists.txt, so it
# cannot be hidden inside ck_project().
project(CocktailEngine LANGUAGES CXX)

# Eventually: find_package(CocktailEngine 1.0 REQUIRED)
# Included directly for now so it can be edited alongside the project.
include(cmake/cocktail_engine.cmake)

# Initialize a project.
# A project has a fixed structure:
# - bin: produced binaries. Will contain program + packaged assets
# - build: resources generated by cmake to build the game
# - intermediate: assets in engine format
# - plugins (optional): subprojects to enhance the engine capabilities
# - resources: raw asset files (gltf, png, ogg...)
# - sources: game source code
# - thirdparty (optional): libraries no single module owns
# This command ensures these directories exist.
ck_project(
    NAME CocktailEngine
	AGGREGATE_TARGET
)

ck_declare_thirdparty(
	glslang
	TARGETS glslang
)

if(CK_BUILD_TESTS)
	ck_declare_thirdparty(
		Catch2
		TARGETS Catch2::Catch2
	)
endif()

ck_add_module(
    Core
    BASE_DIRECTORY runtime
)

ck_add_module(
    Renderer
    BASE_DIRECTORY runtime
    DEPENDS
        CocktailEngine::Core
)

ck_add_module(
    Vulkan
    BASE_DIRECTORY runtime
    DEPENDS
        CocktailEngine::Core CocktailEngine::Renderer
)

ck_add_module(
    Graphic
    BASE_DIRECTORY runtime
    DEPENDS
        CocktailEngine::Core CocktailEngine::Renderer CocktailEngine::Vulkan
)

ck_add_module(
    Main
    STATIC
    MODULE_CLASS OFF
    BASE_DIRECTORY runtime
    DEPENDS
        CocktailEngine::Core
)

ck_add_plugin(
	ImGui
)

ck_add_game(
    Sponza
    BASE_DIRECTORY samples
	DEPENDS
		ImGui::ImGuiIntegration
)

ck_add_game(
    FrustumCulling
    BASE_DIRECTORY samples
	DEPENDS
		ImGui::ImGuiIntegration
)
